children: Australian shares were poised to open lower on Monday, with likely losses in gold stocks from softer bullion prices set to outweigh potential gains in energy stocks from higher oil prices.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.5%, a 21.2-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark ended flat on Friday.
The New Zealand equities market was closed on Monday due to a public holiday.
